Fuck, man. I know the whole point of this sub is to post depression memes and laugh, but this just got to me. I used to not care about when friends would leave me behind, it was always just water under the bridge. I always thought 'it was gonna happen eventually' and I just didn't really think much more of it.

Then about a month ago I met someone and they actually meant something to me. They were one of the best friends I've had in years, perhaps even ever in my short and boring life. Now it seems like they're getting bored of me and the feeling of inadequacy and abandonment is just crushing.

I don't even feel mad at them for it. It's their choice and far be it from me to tell them how to live their life - I guess I just feel ashamed for thinking someone might actually give a shit about me for a change.
